title: Pest Asia Ant Killing Eco Bait For All Type Of Ants, Fire Ants, Black Garden Ants, Little Black Ants
description:
Pest Asia Ant Killing Eco Bait For All Type Of Ants, Fire Ants, Black Garden Ants, Little Black Ants

Features:-
No Mess Or Smell
Easy To Apply
Non Toxic, Non Polluted
Safe To Use
Environmental Friendly

Special Features:-
Domino Effect, Chain Killing Ants
Kill All Kind of Ants include Fire Ants , Big And Small Ants as well
LIquid Form Of Gel Which Need To Apply A Small Dot
Effective and Cost Efficient.

How To Use:-
1.To Apply Gel: Remove Cap, Touch Tip To Surface And Depress Plunger. Apply Gel Only As Spots Or In A Line Along Cracks And Crevices. For First Application, Apply Gel In Four Dime-Sized Spots Or Several 1 To 6 Inch Strips Per Square Yard. Recap Tube After Use
2. Place Many Spots Of Gel Near Area Of Ants Traffic And Suspected Nesting Areas. Also Apply In Cracks, Crevices, Corners And Spots Where Ants Appear
3 Inspect Gel After One Month And Reapply If No Longer Visible. Refresh With A New Application After Three Months. Clean Up Get With A Damp Paper Towel And Discard Towel After Use.

Visit more on:-
